$comment: T-4.27. The vertical slice's two classes (PLAN §1.3, §4.1), as data. Each is a loadout — the guns it carries (weapons.json ids, the first in hand at spawn) and the pouch it spawns with (projectiles.json id → count; an id left out is 0) — its health, and what it may do: `orders` is whom its orders reach, the whole `squad` or only its own `fireteam` (squad.json); target marking is open to everyone (ADR-001). `slotDefaults` is the class each slot takes with no pick — a bot's, and a human's until they choose in the room — so the assault fireteam leads and the overwatch fireteam watches. `required` is what the squad must not lack: bots fill it, lowest slot first, when the humans' picks and the defaults leave it short.
